Aisha (CSM): Thanks everyone — follow-up from the SolsticeMedia kickoff at 10am. Quick snapshot: stakeholders on the call were Raj (PO), Mei (Eng), and Carlos (Security). Main ask: go-live with Redwood text-generation endpoints for content-assist by Day 30. Renewal note: customer flagged timeline and custom SSO as potential risks, so this is a medium renewal-risk right now.

Liam (Solutions): Got it. Proposing a 15-day milestone plan that splits integration + validation. I'll own the integration pattern doc and a sample SDK snippet.

Marta (Onboarding): I'll schedule two enablement sessions next week — one for devs (deep dive) and one for PMs/ops (product + success criteria). Prefer Tue/Wed afternoons.

Nate (CS Engineer): I'll take point on test harness and staging load tests. Need Solstice to provide an allowlist and a staging dataset by EOD Friday.

Raj (Solstice PO): Can confirm we'll have the staging dataset by Thursday. SSO is trickier — Carlos will scope the auth requirements and share a short doc.

Carlos (Solstice Security): Correct. We're limited to SAML+IdP initiated flows. Expect a 5-7d window to provision and validate. That adds to timeline risk.

Aisha (CSM): Action items (owners inline):
- Nate: staging harness + smoke tests (due Day 10)
- Liam: integration pattern + SDK example (due Day 5)
- Marta: enablement sessions + enablement survey (run Day 12)
- Raj/Mei: provide allowlist + sample dataset (due Thu)
- Carlos: SSO requirements doc (due next Tue)

Liam (Solutions): Also adding acceptance criteria so we can call integration "complete":
1) End-to-end request/response in staging for 5 sample prompts
2) 95th perc latency < 400ms in staging under 5 RPS
3) Error rate < 1% for scaffolded calls
4) Enablement survey NPS >= 70 (initial)

Marta (Onboarding): I'll run a short post-enablement feedback capture in Typeform and share results. We'll use that to gate the Day 30 "go/no-go".

Nate (CS Engineer): Quick note — we'll enable prefix caching for common prompts to hit latency target. Need to confirm tokenization expectations with Mei.

Mei (Solstice Eng): Happy to align on tokenization. Also want a short rollback/fallback plan if latency spikes in prod.

Aisha (CSM): Good call. Add rollback: route to a cheaper quantized model variant + rate-limit while we investigate. Liam can draft the fallback policy.

Liam (Solutions): Will do. Draft fallback policy and canary plan by Day 8.

onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: Enablement session #1 (Dev) — Tue 15:00 PST. Reaction: :bell:

Aisha (CSM): I'm capturing these in the playbook page. I'll update the 15-day checklist here for visibility:
```
15-day checklist (high-level)
Day 0-3: API keys issuance, network allowlist, access to staging
Day 4-7: SDK + integration example implemented, basic smoke tests
Day 8-10: Staging load tests, latency/error validation, fallback policy ready
Day 11-15: Enablement sessions, feedback capture, go/no-go retrospective
```

Raj (Solstice PO): That timeline looks doable if SSO is parallelized. We'll push on security.

Carlos (Solstice Security): We'll aim to overlap SSO validation with SDK work to avoid blocking.

Aisha (CSM): Ok — next sync Fri 09:30 to confirm Day 10 staging results. I'll send calendar invites and the Notion link. Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept tasks.
